name: The man who burned my village

steps.line: {name} tells you, late one night, about the fire that took {their} village, and the man who set it.
In a tavern, {name} heard a name {name} has waited years to hear.
The trail leads here. {name} has gone very quiet.
{name} found the man who burned {their} village, and settled it.

done: {name} has nothing left to hunt. For the first time in years, {name} sleeps through the night.

name: Cure my sister

steps.line: {name} keeps a letter from {their} sick sister in {their} coat, and reads it every night.
{name} has been reading every medical book aboard, twice.
{name} has found the medicine. It costs more than {name} has.
The medicine went home on a fast ship. A letter came back: she is getting better.

done: {name}'s sister is well. {name} has never been lighter.

name: Prove the old map true

steps.line: {name} unrolls an old map on the galley table: {their} grandfather's, and everyone said it was a fake.
The coastline here matches the map. {name} is shaking.
Old sailors here remember the island on {name}'s map.
Here it is: exactly where the map said. {name} laughs until the tears come.

done: The old map was true. {name} has written the family name on it, under {their} grandfather's.

name: Become the greatest swordsman

steps.line: {name} trains until {their} hands bleed, and then trains some more.
{name} challenged a swordsman of renown, and won.
{name} swore an oath to you on {their} blade: never to lose again.
{name} faced a better swordsman than any {name} had ever met, and cut through.

done: {name} is not the greatest yet. But the day is coming.

name: The sea where every fish swims

steps.line: {name} tells the crew about a sea where every fish in the world swims together. Nobody laughs.
{name} cooked a fish from the Grand Line nobody aboard had ever seen.
An old cook in port has heard of the sea {name} seeks.

done: {name} has not found it yet. But {name} knows which way it lies now.

name: Clear the family name

steps.line: {name} admits {their} family name is a curse word back home, for something {their} father never did.
{name} has told you the whole story now, piece by piece.
Here lives the one witness who knows the truth.
{name} faced the man who lied about {their} father, and made him tell the truth.

done: {name}'s family name is clean. {name} says it out loud now, proudly.

name: A ship worth building

steps.line: {name} sketches ship designs on every scrap of paper aboard.
{name}'s joints are tighter than any yard's now.
{name} has been talking to every shipwright in port.

done: {name} has drawn the ship {name} will build one day, down to the last nail.

name: Never be weak again

steps.line: {name} tells you about the day {name} could not protect someone.
{name} is training like someone possessed.
{name} stood between the crew and a much bigger fighter, and did not fall.

done: {name} is strong now. Strong enough that it will never happen again.

name: Free my island

steps.line: {name}'s island is ruled by a tyrant. {name} has never said it aloud before.
{name} has found others who want the same.
{name} led the uprising's first fight, and won it.

done: {name}'s island is free. {name} will always have a home there now, and so will you.

name: A love on the far shore

steps.line: {name} writes letters to someone on another island, and never sends them.
{name} told you who the letters are for.
{name} sent every one of the letters at last.

done: A letter came back. {name} reads it every night, smiling.

name: Find where I belong

steps.line: {name} admits joining only for want of anywhere else to go.
{name} has started to talk about the crew as home.
Somewhere new, {name} realised what home was: the ship.

done: {name} knows where home is now: here.

name: Rich enough never to be poor

steps.line: {name} counts {their} share every night, and tells you how poor the family was.
{name} wants to send money home. You helped.
{name} has found a deal worth making.

done: {name}'s family will never go hungry again.
